title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Photocatalytic activity attributed to a molecular cluster requires evidence that the cluster retains its identity under reaction conditions.
explanation: The review recommends complementary solution, leaching, and post-catalytic structural tests to distinguish intact-cluster catalysis from decomposition products.
scope: Molecular 3d-metal cluster photocatalysts, especially water-oxidation catalysts.
conditions: Tests discussed include UV–visible absorption, dynamic light scattering, dissolved-metal analysis, HPLC, powder X-ray diffraction, and XANES/EXAFS.
caveats: Stability observed under one set of photocatalytic conditions should not be assumed under a different applied potential or reaction medium.
